# `tsan` trace fixtures

Real, unedited sanitizer output (stderr) from already-fixed bugs in public projects. Regenerate with `python scripts/capture_sanitizer_fixtures.py --only tsan`.

- Image: `localhost/nikasha-capture:latest` (ID `sha256:65af82bf6f40b11fadf9c06bcd629532c5c49d89cb8351a1e9ab1246f1de9988`) built from `docker/capture/Containerfile`, base `registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44@sha256:b4488a77fd2b96513fc8c18b502df7fbf19dad9e77d9a430c0163c574654822c`
- Compiler in the image: `clang version 22.1.8 (Fedora 22.1.8-4.fc44)`
- Engine: docker, run through `nikasha.repro.sandbox.run_container`
- Each capture was checked: the fixed tag builds and produces no sanitizer report.

| Fixture | Project | Vulnerable | Fixed | Fix commit | Reference | Environment | Script |
